title: Clara’s the best
text: Great tour of Sevilla w Clara, learned all kinds of things I never would’ve figured out from guidebooks or online while walking around.  Great recommendations  on shops, restaurants, etc, to get you going, but everything we did in Sevilla worked out great.
author: Sightseer23574910271

title: Enjoyed it more than I was expecting
text: Carmen really made the stories and history about the place come alive. Really enjoyed it. Very clear speaking. Really felt I learnt something additional about Seville.
author: Conor_D

title: Triana tour
text: Valentino was amazing. He was very passionate on describing Triana and the surrounding areas. Highly recommend!!
author: Shari_D

title: Best area of Seville w an excellent guide
text: Triana is a vibrant area that is worth visiting.  Starting at the Gokden Tower was great because it gave us time for orientation before crossing the bridge into Triana   Carmen was a delightful guide who shared her tips for tapas.
author: Anita_W

title: Great and knowledgeable tour
text: Carlos was great on our trip through Triana. Very recommend! Kind and talkative and funny and intelligent!
author: Maya I

title: An excellent walking tour - highly recommended.
text: The guide created a very interesting and informative experience.  I am so glad that I did this lovely walking tour.
author: Janis_O

title: Great experience with a local passionate guide
text: Antonio was a great guide, very knowledgeable, passionate and open to questions. We felt we learn a lot about Triana and the history of the town and places we visited. Totally recommended, it does absolutely worth it.
author: sergioCe3

title: Interesting tour of Triana.
text: Excellent opportunity to get to know the neighborhood of Triana. Its history, its people, and its characteristics. Fernando, our guide, was wonderful in explaining everything. As a local guide, his passion is evident. We are very grateful; we learned a lot.
author: monicagA2245YM

title: A really interesting walking tour
text: Carmen gave us a really interesting tour of the river, Triana Bridge and Triana. The tour was at a nice leisurely pace.
author: Nicholas M

title: The best company and guide.
text: Antonio was terrific! This tour company is fantastic! Look nowhere else.
author: jamesnancib
